item.title: Mayor: PM Orbán's team may prepare something violent in Győr
item.description: The non-aligned Mayor of Győr, former journalist Bence Pintér, addressed rumours about the Orbán visit in a Facebook post.

item.description: The biggest casualty of Trump's war against Iran is the Hungarian forint amid a looming food price crisis.

item.description: MVM Zöld Generáció, a unit of MVM Group, will build a hybrid geothermal power plant, the first in Hungary.

item.description: The Trump Organisation plans to build its first Romanian project after acquiring the first permission.

item.description: Budapest has again put expanding Danube bathing sites on the agenda, but past experience still urges caution overall.

item.description: HungaroMet has warned of heavy precipitation on Thursday and Friday, with sleet and snow expected in the west.

item.description: The Roma ethnic minority may get a preferential mandate in the next parliament and the top candidate is pro-Orbán.

item.title: Putin may trigger a global food crisis with his latest move hitting Hungary hard despite "friendship"
item.description: Putin's latest move may deliver a stinging blow to the global food system, as the world edges closer to a fresh spike in food-price inflation unseen for decades.

item.title: China Exim Bank ready to set up regional centre in Hungary
item.description: The Export-Import Bank of China is prepared to set up a regional centre in Hungary, FM Szijjártó said.
